project_name: Build a mobile-friendly expense tracker app
description: Build a mobile-friendly expense tracker app for college students to categorize spending, set monthly budgets, and export simple reports by the end of the semester.
summary: A medium complexity analytics reporting project in the analytics domain.

phases.name: Requirements and KPI Definition
phases.objective: Define decision goals, users, metrics, and reporting cadence.

tasks.title: Interview stakeholders
tasks.description: Capture audience, business questions, and reporting needs.
acceptance_criteria: Interview stakeholders is reviewed and accepted by the project lead.

tasks.title: Define metrics
tasks.description: Document KPI formulas, grain, filters, and ownership.
acceptance_criteria: Define metrics is reviewed and accepted by the project lead.

phases.name: Data Discovery and Modeling
phases.objective: Profile source data and create a reliable reporting model.

tasks.title: Profile data sources
tasks.description: Assess schemas, quality gaps, refresh needs, and access constraints.
acceptance_criteria: Profile data sources is reviewed and accepted by the project lead.

tasks.title: Build semantic model
tasks.description: Create tables, relationships, measures, and validation checks.
acceptance_criteria: Build semantic model is reviewed and accepted by the project lead.

phases.name: Report Build and Validation
phases.objective: Create dashboards and validate results with stakeholders.

tasks.title: Build report pages
tasks.description: Create visuals, filters, drill paths, and summary views.
acceptance_criteria: Build report pages is reviewed and accepted by the project lead.

tasks.title: Validate numbers
tasks.description: Reconcile dashboard outputs against source reports or approved samples.
acceptance_criteria: Validate numbers is reviewed and accepted by the project lead.

phases.name: Publish and Enable
phases.objective: Publish the report and support adoption.

tasks.title: Publish workspace artifact
tasks.description: Configure permissions, refresh schedule, and deployment location.
acceptance_criteria: Publish workspace artifact is reviewed and accepted by the project lead.

tasks.title: Train users
tasks.description: Document dashboard usage and review core metrics with stakeholders.
acceptance_criteria: Train users is reviewed and accepted by the project lead.

milestones.name: Requirements and KPI Definition Complete
milestones.description: All deliverables for Requirements and KPI Definition are complete and reviewed.

milestones.name: Data Discovery and Modeling Complete
milestones.description: All deliverables for Data Discovery and Modeling are complete and reviewed.

milestones.name: Report Build and Validation Complete
milestones.description: All deliverables for Report Build and Validation are complete and reviewed.

milestones.name: Publish and Enable Complete
milestones.description: All deliverables for Publish and Enable are complete and reviewed.

dependencies.description: T2 depends on completion of T1.
T3 depends on completion of T2.
T4 depends on completion of T3.
T5 depends on completion of T4.
T6 depends on completion of T5.
T7 depends on completion of T6.
T8 depends on completion of T7.

risks.description: Project scope may expand beyond the initial plan.
risks.mitigation: Maintain an explicit MVP scope and review changes before adding work.

risks.description: Missing stakeholder input may lead to rework.
risks.mitigation: Confirm requirements and acceptance criteria before implementation.

risks.description: Data quality issues may undermine trust in outputs.
risks.mitigation: Profile source data early and validate metrics with stakeholders.

recommendations.rationale: The Phase 1 engine uses limited input and deterministic rules.

recommendations.recommendation: Use milestones as decision gates before expanding scope.
recommendations.rationale: Decision gates reduce rework and keep dependencies visible.

assumptions: No AI provider was used; this is a deterministic Phase 1 mock plan.
